excerpt: We present the combined results on electron-pair production in 158 GeV/n {Pb-Au} ($\sqrt{s}$= 17.2 GeV) collisions taken at the CERN SPS in 1995 and 1996, and give a detailed account of the data analysis. The enhancement over the reference of neutral meson decays amounts to a factor of 2.31$\pm0.19
publisher: CERES/NA45 Collaboration / Eur. Phys. J. C
title: e+e--pair production in Pb-Au collisions at 158 GeV per nucleon
